meta.method: Boc tach tu bang cau truc email sinh vien trong tai lieu (ten truong / ma / dong ten mien / dong mau email). student_usable=true khi: duoi .edu.vn/.ac.vn/.udn.vn, hoac tien to sinh vien (st./sv./student./ms./gm./sis./e.), hoac ten mien xuat hien dung trong mau email cua dong. KHONG chua email ca nhan.
notes: student_usable=true la tap dung de xac thuc email sinh vien luc dang ky.
Ten mien student_usable=false chi luu de tra cuu/anh xa ten truong, khong dung de chap nhan xac thuc.
